subject: Agriculture
title: Insects That Eat Crops
description: A 60-second lesson on Insects That Eat Crops.

hook.text: Insects destroy 20% of global crop production every year—enough to feed a billion people.

buildup.text: Chewing insects eat leaves and stems. Sucking insects drain sap. Boring insects tunnel into stalks and fruit.

discovery.text: A single locust can eat its body weight in food daily. A swarm of billions can strip a region bare in hours.

twist.text: Only about 1% of insect species are crop pests. The other 99% are beneficial or neutral.

climax.text: Killing all insects would collapse agriculture—pollination, decomposition, and pest control all depend on them.

punchline.text: 1% of insects cause the damage. We need the other 99% to survive.

quiz.question: What percentage of insect species are actual crop pests?
